annotation_rule: Equal mean of all source-annotated KIBA targets available in the frozen genetic training library; no target chosen using response agreement
matched_count_rule: For each annotated drug/cell, take the same number of top-ranked DTA targets, with equal weights
chemical_mean_rule: Training chemical responses: average signatures within BRD ID, then BRD IDs within parent, then parents equally; exclude query parent for training-query diagnostics
centering_rule: Subtract the same training-chemical mean vector from prediction and observation; this is a supplementary specificity diagnostic, not revised LINCS preprocessing
scope: Post-result exploratory diagnosis on train/validation only. Validation was used for G2CP checkpoint and original blend selection; it is not an independent confirmation set.
annotation_limit: Source annotations are incomplete and not independently biochemically revalidated. An unannotated target is unknown, not a confirmed negative. This is a privileged-information reference, not an attainable upper bound.
test_policy: No new test scoring, fitting, target selection, or model training
